scientific_checks: Official merged NET Unit 4.A p.5 and separate NET Unit 4.B p.3, MP SET 2024 archived copy p.3 checked visually; map is explicit bacterial chemotaxis. No expansion into quorum sensing or motility ultrastructure.

Reviewed named E. coli model, basal run/tumble, CW/CCW conventions, temporal comparison, direct/indirect MCP recognition, CheW coupling, ATP to His-to-Asp transfer, CheY-P motor switch, CheZ hydrolysis, CheR SAM methyl transfer, CheB methylesterase/deamidase, opposite acute stimulus signs, finite methylation range, exact vs incomplete adaptation, species comparison and energy source. Corrected receptor diagram to explicitly represent two transmembrane helices per subunit.

Landmark Adler 1966, Berg/Brown 1972, Macnab/Koshland 1972 Salmonella, Alon et al. 1999, Cluzel et al. 2000, Sourjik/Berg FRET studies and reviews checked against accessible source records; links added to specific historical/mechanistic passages. Hypothetical numbers and datasets identified as educational. Receptor classes and comparative Bacillus sign checked against review/primary sources.

Reviewed model derivations and assumptions: mass-action occupancy, gradient chain rule, first-order CheY-P relaxation, feedback target and physical constraints, Hill bias, 1-D time-weighted drift, counting noise. Reviewed rescue, epistasis, matched controls and alternative explanations.
